global_caption: The video contains 6 shots. It is a low-saturation pixel-style urban perfume advertisement, presenting a cool tone with slight haze. Neon side lighting and reflections from wet ground serve as consistent lighting throughout. Camera movement is controlled and crisp. The overall mood is calm, detached, yet subtly alluring.
shot1: Shot 1 begins with hard cut from black, wide overhead view of rain-soaked intersection. Zebra stripes and water trails form clear leading lines. Foreground shows wet asphalt sliced by neon lights; background features blurred but densely flashing shop signs. Focus lands on the anime-style girl suddenly stopping in the center and the perfume beside her, emphasized through juxtaposition. Side neon light traces cold, bright outlines around her silhouette and the bottle. She halts, her shoe lightly tapping water, creating small ripples outward. Dense pixel typography appears sequentially in the lower-center and right of screen: "雾落街心" and "像素留香". Camera slowly tilts down and gently pushes in.
shot2: Shot 2 connects via hard cut to previous shot. Medium eye-level shot with lateral dolly. Shop window glass occupies left foreground as reflective layer. Girl positioned mid-right. Soft dim display inside window blends with street reflection. Focus shifts from her profile to the perfume in hand. Neon side light creates fragmented pixel-like highlights on glass and bottle. She slightly turns wrist to raise the bottle, aligning it with her facial outline—forming the core ad image of product and character aura. Camera tracks along window and slightly approaches. A clear door-opening
shot3: Shot 3 transitions via brief dissolve into extreme close-up. Frame nearly filled by perfume bottle. Foreground shows cold reflections on bottle surface; background blurred into soft city neon blocks. Shallow depth of field focuses on slow internal liquid movement and refraction. Low-saturation blue-purple neon glides across liquid surface and glass edges. Liquid gently sways from prior action, forming fine streamlines and viscous texture. Label and corners gradually clarify as camera pushes in slowly, emphasizing premium material quality.
shot4: Shot 4 connects via hard cut to previous shot. Near-extreme close-up, low-angle shot from slightly off-side bottom, looking up at nozzle and girl’s jawline. Nozzle placed at upper golden ratio point. Background streetlight compressed into bokeh depth. Neon side light uniformly outlines her knuckles, nozzle metal edge, and nose bridge. Her finger steadily presses the nozzle. Mist disperses in pixelated particles toward streetlight—first fine droplets, then sheet-like pixel fog—gently drifting over background signs and moist air reflections. Text "冷感扩散" overlays top-left to center, rendered in cold silver pixel grid with radial emergence effect. Camera slightly tilts up during press for burst emphasis.
shot5: Shot 5 enters via hard cut into full tracking shot. Camera follows from girl’s diagonal rear at eye level. She crosses from one end of zebra crossing. Wet shiny road and white lines create strong perspective. Occasional passerby shoulders pass in foreground for layering. Background car lights, convenience store signage, and rain-wet windows maintain coherent urban logic. Neon side light continues to illuminate her silhouette and bottle. Fragrance trail appears as faint pixel mist behind her—subtle but visible. Pedestrians naturally glance back; some slow down, others follow her gaze—external feedback on lingering scent. Camera starts steady, then slightly accelerates forward. Door opening
shot6: Shot 6 connects via slight deceleration followed by static transition. Extreme close-up, eye-level composition places girl’s hair tip and perfume bottle on same focal plane. Hair strands on right foreground, edged by cold side light. Bottle centered slightly left. Background city signs soften into pixel glow spots. Shallow depth emphasizes hair sway and bottle reflection details. After stopping, she slightly turns head; hair moved by passing air and residual fragrance, gently brushing bottle edge—creating delicate tactile sensation. Camera slowly pushes in then freezes. Main slogan "轻喷一下，整座城记住你" appears centered bottom, using low-saturation cold white pixel font with faint neon bleed. Characters pop in individually, then stabilize and hold until end.
